DSTL.description: Design Steel Data (DSTL). A single-instance record (key is always 1) holding the steel design code; the DGNCODE string is matched (case- and space-insensitively) against the program's registered steel code name list and converted to the canonical code name.

DGNCODE.description: Steel design code name. Matched against the program's registered steel code list ignoring case and spaces, then stored as the canonical name (e.g. 'Eurocode3-2:05', 'AISC-LRFD05'). Changing an existing code resets previously stored design code data.
